Integrated process of ammonia cracking and reverse water gas shift
top_patents.abstract:
[0001]    Title: Integrated process of ammonia cracking and reverse water gas shift
[0002]    Process for the production of carbon monoxide, said process comprising:
• providing an ammonia stream and a carbon dioxide stream,
• performing an endothermic cracking reaction of said ammonia stream for producing a cracked gas (5) comprising hydrogen and nitrogen,
• performing a reverse water gas shift reaction with said hydrogen from the cracked gas and said carbon dioxide stream as reactants, for producing a product gas (6) comprising carbon monoxide and water.
